sources.title: What are Diffusion Models? - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: Diffusion models are a type of generative AI that create data like images or audio by starting from random noise and gradually refining it into meaningful output. They learn this process by adding noise to real data during training and then reversing it step by step. This allows them to generate realistic and high-quality samples from scratch.
